A grapevine crosses one foot in front, steps to the side, crosses behind, then steps to the side. Here it is a movement pattern, not a complete named folk dance.
A Danish folk dance adds a held action each round. Later actions move down toward the floor. This short classroom adaptation uses knee lifts and kneeling. It is not the complete traditional dance.

A dance from the Philippines, named for the tikling bird. Two people tap bamboo poles on the ground twice, then close them. The dancer hops in, in, and out, and the poles get faster. In class, use tape lines or ropes on the floor instead of poles.
